items.title: Researcher Released Windows Defender 0-Day Exploit Code, Allowing Attackers to Gain Full Access
items.description: A security researcher operating under the alias Chaotic Eclipse (@ChaoticEclipse0) has publicly dropped a working zero-day local privilege escalation (LPE) exploit for Windows, dubbed BlueHammer, along with full proof-of-concept (PoC) source code on GitHub. The disclosure was confirmed by vulnerability researcher Will Dormann, who noted that the exploit works and that Microsoft’s own security…
